properties.title: HounsWorld: A Multimodal World Model for Hidden Patient-State Readout, Reconstruction, and Simulation
properties.source_availability_basis: Assigned local PDF SHA-256 was recomputed and matches assignments.json.

properties.version_date: arXiv margin: 13 Aug 2026; PDF body: August 14, 2026
properties.hash_verification: Recomputed SHA-256 matches the assignment-pinned PDF.
properties.text_cache_provenance: 26 form-feed chunks in the alternate extraction align with the version/title/page count; cache provenance is corroborated but not cryptographically tied to the assigned PDF hash.

properties.name: HounsWorld
properties.role: CT-centered multimodal model for readout, same-state reconstruction and condition-specified CT observation generation.
properties.membership_boundary: Strict ontology world-model identity unresolved: implicit state and target-observation generation are described, but a separate persistent-state transition is not established.
properties.clinical_action_boundary: Target acquisition/observation conditions are not treatment actions or causal intervention effects.

properties.composition_pattern: Shared state-space (author-described implicit shared representation); no planner in the reported HounsWorld workflow.
flow: language readout and CT latent-generation outputs
properties.evaluation_scope: Task-specific retrospective image/readout evaluations; no prospective clinical workflow evaluation.

properties.design: Model development with task-specific retrospective HounsBench evaluations and appendices; not a prospective clinical study.
properties.independence: One paper/version and linked task-family benchmark; do not count result tables as independent replications.
properties.limitations: Patient-level split claims are reported, but broad cross-task overlap audit and subject metadata are not established in the reviewed text.

assertions.rationale: Some dataset and split provenance is described, but it is not a full reproducible lineage contract.
criteria_met: Names multiple source datasets/task-family data and describes task-specific construction and split units.
criteria_missing: A complete source-to-example provenance ledger, exact cross-task overlap audit, and patient-level metadata for every task are not established in the reviewed text.

A.2 Scope and Source Data
Readout supervision is derived from CT-RATE Hamamci et al. (2026) and M3D Bai et al. (2024). CT-RATE
provides chest CT volumes paired with radiology reports; M3D supplies whole-body CT image–text and VQA
examples. Our CT-language instruction construction follows the data protocol introduced with OmniCT Lin
et al. (2026); Section B states the operational transformations used inHounsBenchand adds a turn-level
canonicalization layer required by mixed language and CT-completion training. Report and caption targets
remain in the Readout evaluation inventory because they share its language scoring protocol, while their
full-state recovery is interpreted methodologically as same-state language reconstruction.
The state-conditioned CT pools use private collected cohorts and public CT data. They comprise low-dose-
to-routine-dose reconstruction att, non-contrast-to-arterial/venous pancreatic simulation att+ ∆t, and
text-plus-semantic-mask-conditioned CT generation spanningt/t+ ∆t. Anatomical masks are inferred au-
tomatically with TotalSegmentator. All reported counts come from final materialized, patient-disjoint training
and evaluation records rather than nominal source-dataset sizes. Figure 5 integrates source, supervision, state

scope.time_horizon: Condition-specified short-horizon target observation; no clinical duration reported.

capability_assessments.rationale: The source demonstrates condition-specified target-observation generation and describes an implicit patient-state representation. Under ontology v1.0.1, core membership requires an implemented persistent state advanced by a learned/hybrid transition over a declared health-world coordinate; the reviewed equations do not establish that separate transition. Therefore strict membership/capability is unresolved (unknown), not silently promoted from the author label. Legacy L2 is retained as a separate workbook classification for acquisition-condition prediction.

scope.time_horizon: Task-specific held-out target observations/readout; no prospective clinical workflow.

legacy_cells.B: HounsWorld: A Multimodal World Model for Hidden Patient-State Readout, Reconstruction, and Simulation
legacy_cells.C: Yunhao Bai; Zhongwei Qiu; Guangyu Guo; Yiming Huang; Tony C. W. Mok; Qinji Yu; Ling Zhang; Yan Wang
legacy_cells.S: Can a shared CT-centered patient-state representation support clinical readout, same-state reconstruction, and condition-specified future CT observation prediction?
legacy_cells.AI: 3D CT volumes; radiology reports and clinical text/questions; anatomical masks; CT acquisition descriptors (contrast phase, dose, HU window)
legacy_cells.AJ: CT semantic vision encoder and Wan VAE encoder feed a shared 36-layer transformer; CT completion is decoded through the VAE pathway.
legacy_cells.AK: Wan VAE and pretrained Lance latent connectors
legacy_cells.AM: Shared multimodal token stream and transformer integrate CT and language observations with masks and target-condition descriptors.
legacy_cells.BD: Target contrast phase, acquisition dose, and HU window; target phase is specified for non-contrast-to-arterial/venous transfer.
legacy_cells.BS: Query answers, reports/captions, and CT volumes for low-dose denoising, contrast transfer, and text-and-mask-conditioned generation.
legacy_cells.BT: Shared language readout head for answers/reports/captions and CT generation head for conditional VAE-latent completion.
legacy_cells.BU: HounsWorld is also evaluated as a frozen reward model for GRPO training of Qwen3-VL-4B.
legacy_cells.BV: Autoregressive language cross-entropy plus CT latent flow-matching/MSE loss; combined as L_HW = L_lang + λ_ct Σ_k π_k L_ct_k.
legacy_cells.CA: bfloat16 FSDP on 16 GPUs; Stage 1 ran 1,170 steps and Stage 2 ran 9,943 steps.
legacy_cells.DN: HounsBench; CT-RATE; M3D; private collected dataset
legacy_cells.DQ: HounsBench-Readout: approximately 1.43M training samples and 34K held-out evaluation samples; 6.9K LDCT-denoising pairs; 7.1K contrast-transfer pairs; 188K text-and-mask-to-CT examples and 47.1K target CT/mask pairs.
legacy_cells.DX: Contrast transfer (HounsWorld): PSNR 31.343; SSIM 0.8997; RMSE 0.0295. LDCT denoising: PSNR 30.196; SSIM 0.7631; RMSE 0.0322.
legacy_cells.DZ: Text+mask-to-CT: CT-KID 0.075 and LPIPS 0.3056 (table reports CT-KID at 10^3 scale).
legacy_cells.EI: Compared with non-WM task-specific baselines: denoising RED-CNN PSNR 31.382 vs HounsWorld 30.196; contrast SMILE PSNR 30.736 vs HounsWorld 31.343; text+mask MAISI PSNR 18.780 vs HounsWorld 17.354.
legacy_cells.EK: Ablations vary denoising, contrast transfer, text+mask completion, combined CSPC, condition-explicit observations, partial CT observation, and reward transfer to Qwen3-VL.
legacy_cells.EL: Reported qualitative limitations: fine parenchymal texture and small vascular detail are smoother than paired ground truth; fine lung texture and small intra-organ structures also remain smoother than ground truth.
legacy_cells.EO: Supplementary statistics expose aggregate counts and deterministic category labels only; protected patient metadata are not released.
legacy_cells.FB: Implicit shared patient-state representation of volumetric anatomy, tissue attenuation, lesion manifestation, and enhancement behavior, inferred from partial CT, language, and condition observations.
legacy_cells.FL: CT semantic vision encoder and VAE encoder produce tokens; a shared 36-layer transformer forms the implicit patient-state representation; language readout and CT flow-matching generation heads produce answers, reports/captions, and condition-specific CT observations; no planner is implemented.
legacy_cells.FM: Introduces HounsWorld, a shared CT-centered multimodal patient-state model and HounsBench, unifying readout, same-state reconstruction, and condition-shifted simulation with patient-disjoint evaluation.
legacy_cells.FN: HounsWorld achieved 31.343 PSNR and 0.0295 RMSE on contrast transfer; 30.196 PSNR on denoising; and 0.075 CT-KID on text+mask-to-CT. The paper reports competitive CT readout and improvement from completion supervision.
legacy_cells.FO: Evidence is limited to condition-specified short-horizon observations; it does not establish long-term disease evolution, treatment response, or diagnostic interchangeability of generated CT. The authors state that fine details remain smoother than ground truth.
legacy_cells.FP: The authors state that blinded radiologist and external-reader studies remain necessary.
legacy_cells.FQ: The authors identify fragmented task-specific medical AI supervision and the lack of an explicitly shared patient-specific representation transferable across tasks and conditions.
legacy_cells.FR: Results support shared-state readout, reconstruction, and condition-specified short-horizon observation generation, not long-term patient dynamics, treatment-effect simulation, identified counterfactual treatment effects, diagnostic interchangeability, prospective clinical benefit, or planning/control.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M3 Belief-state service; M4 Action service; M5 Dynamics adapter; M7 Outcome & causal layer
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Pass the paper’s specified action and time context explicitly into the state-transition interface; preserve the boundary between predictive action sensitivity and identified intervention effects.
legacy_cells.FX: Complete 26-page extracted PDF text, pages 1–26: title and abstract (p. 1); introduction and related work (pp. 1–4); methods and architecture (pp. 3–5); experiments, quantitative results, qualitative findings, and ablations (pp. 5–9); conclusion and limitations (p. 10); appendix dataset documentation, data splits, metrics, visual examples, training details, quality control, privacy, and limitations (pp. 14–26). | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: A:I were left untouched. The extracted figure/table layout is partly garbled, although the quoted metrics and counts used here are legible. The world-model classification is bounded to condition-specified acquisition/observation prediction; the paper does not demonstrate treatment-conditioned physiological dynamics, causal treatment effects, long-term disease progression, or planning/control. Evidence QA: 52/72 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (72.2%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. limitations: Assigned PDF hash matches assignments.json; alternate cache page mapping aligns by title/version and 26-page count but extraction provenance is not cryptographically tied to the PDF.

Text review covers physical pages 1–26; all inventoried figures and tables across pages 2, 3, 6–9, 14–21, and 23–25 were directly visually inspected via rendered PNGs during Phase E repair (prose-only pages 5, 10–13, 22, 26 were reviewed via extracted text).
Strict ontology world-model membership is unknown because target observation generation is not shown to advance a persistent patient state.
Contrast/acquisition condition prediction is not treatment response, causal effect identification, clinical decision planning, or diagnostic interchangeability.
No external validation, reader study, prospective workflow, patient benefit, or clinical deployment evidence was established.
